Fly_Swatter_Brush_Tail.description: The Fly_Swatter_Brush_Tail is a colossal appendage, reminiscent of an elephant's trunk but adorned with bristly hairs that rustle softly as the tail sweeps through the air. Its thick, muscular structure allows for powerful and precise movements, enabling the wielder to engage in rapid, agility-enhancing attacks with the Tail Whip skill.

Thick_Club_Tail.description: The Thick_Club_Tail is a ponderous appendage, reminiscent of an elephant's trunk but armored with thick, knobby scales that form a natural club at the tip. It swings with devastating force, capable of knocking down foes with a single strike, embodying raw power and brute strength.

Spined_War_Tail.description: The Spined_War_Tail is a thick, muscular appendage, ending in a bony, spiked club that resonates with latent power, capable of delivering devastating blows. Covered in sharp spines that can tear through flesh with a flick, it thrums with a readiness for battle, enhancing the bearer's strength and natural defenses.

Rudder_Aquatic_Tail.description: The elephantine aquatic tail, with its broad, flat fluke and sleek, muscular body, undulates gracefully through water, providing unmatched stability and maneuverability. Its tough, yet flexible hide feels like smooth, cool stone when touched, and its presence grants the wielder unparalleled agility and speed beneath the waves.

Balance_Heavy_Tail.description: The Balance_Heavy_Tail is a colossal appendage, thick and muscular like an elephant’s trunk but ending in a heavy, spiked ball that acts as a counterweight, granting unparalleled stability and balance in even the most treacherous terrain.

Whip_Strike_Tail.description: The Elephantine Whip Tail is a fearsome appendage, thick and sinewy like coiled steel, its dark, leathery surface glistening with an otherworldly sheen. When extended, it lashes out with the speed and power of a whip, capable of striking enemies from afar with devastating force.

Prehensile_Heavy_Tail.description: The Prehensile Heavy Tail is a colossal appendage, thick as a grown man’s torso and covered in rough, dark scales that glisten with an eerie sheen in the dim light. Its powerful muscles allow it to grip and manipulate objects with surprising dexterity, despite its bulk, and it can ensnare and grapple foes with crushing force.

Necrotic_Rotting_Tail.description: The Necrotic_Rotting_Tail is a grotesque appendage, swollen and distended like that of a colossal elephant, yet it is deathly cold to the touch with the texture of rotten, decayed flesh. It thrums with a malevolent energy, capable of delivering a venomous bite that infects foes with a lingering disease while granting the wielder a measure of resistance to such maladies.

Mammoth_Woolly_Tail.description: The Woolly Mammoth's tail is a dense, shaggy appendage, covered in thick, insulating fur that sways ponderously, radiating an aura of ancient resilience and cold resistance.

Electrosensory_Trailing_Tail.description: The Electrosensory Trailing Tail is a thick, sinuous appendage, reminiscent of an elephant's, covered in small, sensitive nodes that tingle and pulse with the electrical currents of the environment, granting unparalleled awareness of nearby vibrations and movements.

Titan_Hammer_Tail.description: The Titan_Hammer_Tail is a colossal appendage, resembling the trunk of an elephant but armored in thick, knobby scales that gleam with an ominous metallic sheen. Its movements are sluggish yet powerful, capable of delivering devastating blows that crack the earth beneath them, embodying raw, unyielding strength.

Stub_Vestigial_Tail.description: The stub of a vestigial tail, thick and roped with sinew like an elephant's trunk, rests incongruously at the base of the spine, its surface rough with calluses from forgotten use, hinting at a past life of cumbersome mobility now reduced to a mere relic.
